# Quillframe

> AI-native long-form fiction framework and authoring environment. The host runs the agent; Quillframe governs Project story state, Canon boundaries, bounded Context, quality gates, review/release, persistence, and authorized Settlement; external models provide inference.

Canonical site: https://quillframe.wei-dev.com/
Documentation: https://quillframe.wei-dev.com/docs/
Studio: https://studio.quillframe.wei-dev.com/
Repository: https://github.com/xiaooye/cn_webnovel_agent
Markdown sitemap: https://quillframe.wei-dev.com/sitemap.md
Full machine-oriented guide: https://quillframe.wei-dev.com/llms-full.txt
Authentication note: https://quillframe.wei-dev.com/auth.md

## Content-use signal

Quillframe public content is available for search indexing and real-time AI reference/grounding. AI training or fine-tuning is not granted by the repository license. The deployed site expresses `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no`; the exact legal terms remain authoritative.

## Authority boundaries

Plan != Canon. Review != Accepted. Accepted != Settled. Stored != injected. Persistence != authority. Public web pages and Agent Skills do not grant Canon, Project-write, Framework-write, or Settlement authority.
